entities.summary: Yerofey Pavlovich Khabarov-Svyatitsky, was a Russian entrepreneur and zemleprokhodets, best known for his exploring the Amur river region and his attempts to colonize the area for Russia. For background, see Russian–Manchu border conflicts.
